PRJNA1381823 (xylan 2 h, replicate 3) is registered but has no reads in ENA

study_summary.objective: Profile how wild-type RIB40 reprograms its transcription on plant polysaccharides and biomass, to understand how variations in the regulatory system of different fungi affect enzyme production (from the BioSample text).
study_summary.experimental_design: RIB40 grown in 1% D-xylose (2 h), D-xylan, D-xyloglucan, WB or SBH (2 h and 8 h each), 3 replicates per condition (2 for xylan at 2 h); one single-run BioProject per sample, from the DOE JGI; medium and pre-growth are not stated.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

rib40_wild_type.note: wording 'cells grown in 1% ...' implies liquid culture; not stated

soybean_hulls.note: '1% SBH' read as soybean hulls; abbreviation not spelled out in the record

notes: The JGI deposited every sample as its own BioProject; the atlas groups the 26 as one study (docs/decisions/0009-study-groups.md) and keeps each run's original BioProject in samples.source_bioproject.
Planned design is 5 substrates x 2 times x 3 replicates = 30; D-xylose was not sampled at 8 h in the deposited data and xylan at 2 h lacks replicate 3, leaving 26 runs.
'WB' and 'SBH' are read as wheat bran and soybean hulls; the records give only the abbreviations.
Culture medium, temperature and pre-growth carbon source are marked missing in the BioSamples, so only substrate, time and strain are tagged.
